svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four lengths of U-channel, mitred 45 degrees: two 1,100 (north and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: south), two 1,000 (east and west), outside sizes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide them onto the polycarbonate sheet (1,096 x 996, flutes running

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: north to south); seal the low (south) flute ends with breather tape

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the high ends with aluminium tape first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Join each corner with a 20 x 20 x 2 angle bracket inside the channel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: web, two 3.2 mm rivets each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinges: three 60 mm stainless butt hinges on the north side, 440 west

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of centre, at centre and 470 east; rivet one leaf to the frame and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screw the other into the north wall's top batten.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Latches: two over-centre latches on the south side, 475 each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre; keeper riveted to the frame, body screwed to the wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the frame rests on an EPDM seal on the wall tops.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lid closes evenly on the seal all round.
